maya (marketing): Quick sync - aiming for Tue 08:00 PT public announce. Need final changelog + docs links + one-line bench blurb. Any API changes?
jordan (eng): No breaking API changes. New quantized model variant and a `perf_mode` flag. Draft changelog incoming.
tara (docs): I can publish a release page once I have changelog + sample curl. ETA today EOD.
maya (marketing): Perfect. Also planning Wed 11am PT webinar demo. Ben will run product demo; need 2 slides of bench takeaways.
ben (product): Bench ask: p50/p95 and token-cost delta for the typical 128-token prompt.
jordan (eng): Quick bench: rwd-4-small-quant, 128 tokens -> p50 45ms, p95 125ms, ~27% token cost reduction vs rwd-4-small. Will share the exact config.
nina (growth): For inbound: route blog leads to sales@redwood, add Drift tag "bench-interest", and capture volume + use-case in lead form.
tara (docs): Draft URL: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/rwd4-quant (placeholder). I'll include sample curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-4-small-quant","input":"Summarize product updates","max_tokens":128}'
```
jordan (eng): Changelog bullets:
- rwd-4-small-quant (4-bit) with ~27% cost reduction
- KV-cache recall optimizations
- new `perf_mode` flag for batching tuning
maya (marketing): Embargo internal until Tue 07:00 PT. Canary planned Mon 23:30 PT 10% -> full ramp Tue 04:00 PT if metrics stable.
